en.description:

I gave WOOBIN Lego as a gift for the first timeHahaha
I couldn't play with toys a lot when I was youngLOL
I gave him branches that fell on the street and played around

Since I'm in the position of my parents, I want to do one more thing for them

What if Woobin asks me to buy it even after 40? If Woobin is 40 years old, I'm over 80...
